learning_outcomes.statement: The learner can write for loops with all three range() signatures, use enumerate() and counter/accumulator patterns, and combine loops with conditions including nested loops.

The learner can write while loops including while True+break, distinguish break from continue and use loop-else, recognize the chapter's 10 named loop-bug categories, and automate Turtle drawings (polygons, mandalas, spirals) with real rendered output.

criteria.rationale: No factual defects found; every range()/enumerate()/break/continue/loop-else/off-by-one claim independently re-executed under Python 3.14.6 and confirmed correct, including exact ValueError text for a zero step.
All API usage matches Python 3.14's standard library with no deprecated usage; range()'s lazy-generator nature and exclusive-stop rule verified accurate.
Precise, consistent loop vocabulary (цикл, тело цикла, итерация, счётчик, накопитель, сентинел); register entries added for all of these.
The opener promises for/range/enumerate/nested-loops/while/break-continue/loop-else/search-filter-sum/input-validation/debugging/Turtle-automation; all delivered with no gap.
All real-rendered Turtle output independently validated via scripts/validate_chapter_10_outputs.py (14/14 non-empty PNGs), guaranteeing code/image correspondence by construction.
Concrete, checkable scope (automate every Chapter 6-7 figure, build a fully-featured guessing game v2) rather than vague aspirations.
Assumes only Chapters 1-9; every new term is introduced before use, and the exclusive-stop rule is explicitly and correctly tied to the already-taught Chapter 8 slice convention.
Opens with everyday repetition (brushing teeth) before Python syntax, then a concrete pain point (rewriting code 20 times for a 20-gon) motivating loops.
16 sections chunked into clear sub-arcs (for basics -> while -> break/continue -> patterns -> guessing game v2 -> debugging -> Turtle automation).
10-13's ten-named-bug catalog and the chapter's closing decision-map/toolkit provide genuine, comprehensive consolidation.
Loop vocabulary used identically across all 16 sections and correctly carried forward into Chapter 11's list-iteration material.
All internal cross-references verified to point to sections that exist and contain the referenced content.
The off-by-one term from Chapter 9 is explicitly reused, not redefined; the continue-before-update caution in 10-04 is correctly and explicitly referenced again as bug #6 in 10-13's catalog.
Chapter number, title, and all 16 section identifiers match the PAGES navigation model and sidebar exactly.
